name: AIxuanfeng

sources.title: AI旋风 homepage — Chinese AI-tools navigation directory
友情链接 (friendly links) page — the only documented application path: leave a comment with site name, link and description

conditions: No self-serve submit form was found; the public route is the friendly-link (友链) application — leave a comment on /links/ with your site name, URL and description
Applicant is expected to add AI旋风's link to their own site first ('可先做好本站链接并此处留言') — reciprocal backlink expected
Site must be a legitimate, regularly updated site with normal Baidu and Google indexing; low-original-content or long-unmaintained sites are refused
requirements: AI-related or content-adjacent Chinese website preferred ('优先招同类原创、内容相近的博客或网站')
Normal inclusion in Baidu and Google with a recent Baidu snapshot
No content violating Chinese law; no TB-affiliate or spam sites
Reciprocal link to https://www.aixuanfeng.com expected before applying (site name: AI旋风; icon URL provided on the links page)
preparation: Your site name, URL and a short description in Chinese
AI旋风's link already placed on your site (name: AI旋风, URL: https://www.aixuanfeng.com, icon: https://www.aixuanfeng.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/AI.png)
Evidence the site is live, indexed and regularly updated
workflow: Add the AI旋风 friendly link to your own site
Leave a comment containing your site name, URL and related description
Wait for the site owner to reply in the comment thread ('我将尽快答复')
watchFor: This is a friend-link exchange, not a catalog submission — a tool listing in the main directory may not be obtainable through this route
The site is China-hosted (Alibaba Cloud, Hangzhou) and Chinese-language only; tools unreachable from China may be declined
Comments asking for a homepage link without the required quality criteria are explicitly refused
Domain registration shows expiry in August 2026 — verify the site is still maintained before investing effort
countsAsLive: Your site appears either as a friend link on aixuanfeng.com/links/ or as an entry in the tool navigation listings
unknowns: Whether a dedicated tool-submission channel exists beyond the friend-link comment route — none was found on public pages
Whether English-language tools are accepted into the main directory
Review turnaround time for friend-link applications
